Issue: Active test account has no valid role/entity context
Expected: The supplied role/entity mapping should permit context selection or direct entry
Actual: Login is refused with 'No login context assigned'
Evidence: Browser verified; PPNO 704003; screenshot captured in review run
Recommended Fix: Correct and validate the active user-context assignment; add an administrative pre-flight report for active users without valid contexts

Issue: Credential values are stored in a tracked application settings file
Expected: Secrets should be supplied by a protected secret store or deployment environment and excluded from source control
Actual: Non-empty database/email credential fields are present in tracked configuration
Evidence: Source verified; secret values deliberately excluded
Recommended Fix: Rotate exposed credentials, purge them from repository history where feasible, move secrets to protected deployment configuration, and add secret scanning

Issue: Generic object-scope enforcement recognizes only user identifiers
Expected: All business-object identifiers should be mapped to enforceable entity/branch/zone/engagement/observation/para scope
Actual: Entity and business-record identifiers are not extracted by the global filter; enforcement depends on downstream code
Evidence: Source verified; browser exploitation not yet confirmed
Recommended Fix: Expand typed object-scope mapping and require fail-closed scope checks for every identifier-bearing endpoint; retain database predicates as defense in depth

Issue: Visible sidebar page and Logout links do not navigate
Expected: Selecting a page should open it; selecting Logout should invalidate the session and return promptly to login
Actual: Clicks leave the user on /Home/Index; direct /Login/Logout navigation is required and is intermittently slow
Evidence: Browser verified for Logout under ADMINS and HEAD CAD and for Monitoring of Settled Paras under role 45; source shows a capture-phase sidebar handler collapsing the sidebar before navigation plus a logout location handler
Recommended Fix: Correct event ordering so link activation is preserved; regression-test every sidebar link and both logout links; measure session-disposal latency

Issue: A settled para is displayed with a blank Para No.
Expected: Every settled para should retain and display its unique para number
Actual: August 2026 result for BRANCH - SEHNSA has no para number
Evidence: Browser verified; role 45; month Aug; year 2026; screenshot captured
Recommended Fix: Trace the report query to the settlement record and enforce non-null para identity before settlement; reconcile existing affected data

Issue: Report table is unusable at the tested in-app browser width and full-page capture duplicates/overflows content
Expected: Columns should remain readable using responsive layout or intentional horizontal scrolling without duplicated page fragments
Actual: Headings and values wrap character-by-character; title/gist becomes a very tall column and page/footer content is visually repeated
Recommended Fix: Add a responsive table container, sensible minimum column widths, truncation/detail expansion for long text, and print-specific CSS; test common desktop and tablet widths

Issue: Start/end chronology and duplicate/overlap rules are not enforced by the UI endpoint or Oracle procedure
Expected: Start must be on/before End and duplicate/overlapping periods must be rejected atomically
Actual: Client checks only blanks; controller parses dates without chronology validation; Oracle overlap check is commented out
Evidence: Browser prepared reversed dates without validation; source and Oracle package verified; invalid record was not submitted to avoid polluting test data
Recommended Fix: Add server-side chronology and overlap validation inside one database transaction; restore an atomic uniqueness/overlap rule and return structured validation errors
